description: This file provides utility functions and enums for parsing integers from strings in the context of network protocols, with specific handling to avoid common bugs associated with string-to-integer conversions.

classes.name: ParseIntFormat
classes.description: Enumeration specifying the format to use when parsing integers, including options for non-negative, optionally negative, and strict variants.

classes.name: ParseIntError
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the reason why a parsing function failed, such as overflow, underflow, or invalid format.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details if applicable.

methods.name: ParseInt64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details if applicable.

methods.name: ParseUint32
methods.description: Parses a string into a 32-bit unsigned integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details if applicable.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a string into a 64-bit unsigned integer according to the specified format, returning success status and error details if applicable.
